lines.t: The world is a movie I’ve already seen
Flickering shadows on a dirty screen
I see the neon, I hear the roar
But I don’t belong to that house anymore
I remember the craving, the hunger, the thirst
Putting the hunger for anything first
But the deeper I ran, the thinner I grew
Until I was nothing... then I found You.
And now I have a quiet room inside
Where the waves don't reach and the shadows hide
It doesn’t matter what the world wants to be
I have the King sitting right here with me
You are my love... You are my breath
The only hand that can pull me from death.
I watch from the window, I watch from the gate
I see her running, and I know the weight
Of trying to fill up a hole in the soul
With pieces of glass and things you can't hold
My heart is a bruise, but my spirit is still
I’m standing like stone on the side of a hill
I can’t make her stay, and I can’t make her see
But I won't let the darkness take hold of me.
I’m not the girl by the riverbank now
I’ve got a crown on my spirit, a light on my brow
Even if everything burns to the floor
I’m staying right here... behind this door.
You’re enough for me.
You’re enough.
(Whispered)
I’m not going back.
I’m home.
[End]
